items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: At that time, Kid Rainier was playing on that story, featuring, what's the point of the name? Alto. Teddy. Theda. Theda O'Painal. ... Chester on bass. Randy had a woman... And his brother Joe, and they had Henry Harden on it.

ctx.x: Chester's ours. Chester told him no, he wasn't gonna leave in yours. At that time, Kid Rainier was playing on that story, featuring, what's the point of the name? Alto. Teddy. Theda. Theda O'Painal. We can put that old point of on the alto. Mmhmm. Theda. Chester. Chester on bass. Randy had a woman, I never, never did know her name, playing the piano. And his brother Joe, and they had Henry Harden on it. She's a tenor. They used a couple of nights out.
Hmm? Go ahead, nothing. Did what? Nothing. I'm about to fall asleep. I'm tired, I was out late last night. You tired? Yeah. Yeah. Shots worked on their job for us too. Mmhmm. Mmhmm. Mmhmm.
